summary: The artifact is syntactically valid and uses Playwright APIs correctly, preserving the test case ID in the test title. The test navigates and clicks correctly and asserts on URL asynchronously. However, the selector [data-test="product-1"] appears to be a hardcoded guess without evidence it is robust. The URL assertion is weak, only checking for a substring 'product'. There are no assertions on page content to verify the product detail page fully. Test data is hardcoded and not abstracted, limiting reusability and maintainability.

issues.description: The selector '[data-test="product-1"]' appears hardcoded and may not be robust or scalable.
issues.recommendation: Use more semantic or data attributes designed for reliable test selectors or abstract selectors into constants.

issues.description: The URL assertion uses a loose regex (/product/) which may pass incorrectly and does not confirm the exact product detail page.
issues.recommendation: Add more specific assertions such as verifying page content or exact URL including product id or name.

issues.description: Test data (product-1) is hardcoded inside the test, reducing reusability and flexibility.
issues.recommendation: Define test data externally or as constants for easier updates and enhanced maintainability.

recommendations: Enhance assertions to validate the loaded product detail page more conclusively, e.g., check for product title, image, or price on the page.
Use more robust selectors or abstract selector strings into variables to improve maintainability.
Avoid hardcoding test data; consider using configuration files or environment variables for dynamic data.
